component.name: Authenticator
component.summary: Two-factor codes, on Proton Authenticator's open-source core

description.p: A native COSMIC app for two-factor (TOTP and Steam) codes. Codes, imports, exports and encryption come from Proton Authenticator's open-source Rust core. Not an official Proton app.

ul.li: Add codes from a setup key, a QR code image or an otpauth:// link
Import from Proton Authenticator, Proton Pass, Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden, Ente, LastPass and Google Authenticator
Export as a Proton Authenticator file, with or without a password
Sign in with a Proton account to get your codes from it (one-way sync for now)
Codes are encrypted on disk, with the key in the system keyring or behind an app password

description.p: Builds with Rust 1.99.1 and updates libcosmic, Proton's core, keyring, the encryption libraries and other dependencies. Signed builds are now published as a Flatpak repository.
